notes: Adds a Brand-scoped Content Asset Library as a secondary Kairo workspace surface.
Persists library metadata and indexed asset metadata in Postgres with strict account/Brand scoping.
Introduces a provider connector contract and deterministic no-network foundation only; live Google Drive OAuth/network access is deferred to VS-60.
Content Assets remain separate from Brand Brain evidence and never become confirmed Brand truth automatically.
Vercel Git-triggered deployment remains disabled and this slice has no deployment approval.

approvals.rationale: Owner instructed Go after selecting Content Asset Library foundation as the next Kairo capability.
This slice defines a connector boundary only and does not enable Google OAuth, provider credentials, external Drive calls, deployment, or production activation.
Go authorizes bounded implementation, tests, UI review and exact-head certification gates. Merge and deployment remain separate approvals.
Implementation head passed Product Intake #609, Security #702, CI #820 and implementation-level UI Review. Final exact-candidate gates are running after this governance-only transition.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate production-enable and provider-connection approval is required.
